description: Source code implementing hardware decode target handling for Windows, including texture allocation, updating, and OpenGL/EGL integration for YUV and RGBA formats.

classes.name: HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate
classes.description: Class managing hardware decode target textures and EGL surfaces for Windows, supporting YUV and RGBA formats.

methods.name: AllocateTexture
methods.description: Allocates a Direct3D 11 texture based on the specified format, width, and height.

methods.name: UpdateTexture
methods.description: Updates a D3D11 texture with data from a video sample, setting up video processor input and output views.

methods.name: HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate::HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing textures and EGL surfaces based on video sample and format.

methods.name: HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate::InitTextureYUV
methods.description: Initializes EGL and OpenGL textures for YUV format using ANGLE and EGL.

methods.name: HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate::InitTextureRGBA
methods.description: Initializes EGL and OpenGL textures for RGBA format.

methods.name: HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate::~HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate
methods.description: Destructor releasing EGL surfaces and textures.

methods.name: HardwareDecodeTargetPrivate::Update
methods.description: Updates the decode target textures with new video sample data if conditions are met.
